# gigahost_account (Data Source)

Returns the authenticated account's profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gigahost_account" "example" {}

output "account_email" {
  value = data.gigahost_account.example.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Street address.
- `address2` (String) Second address line.
- `bandwidth_notification` (Boolean) True when the account receives bandwidth alerts.
- `billing_email` (String) Email invoices are sent to.
- `city` (String) City.
- `company_no` (String) Company registration number.
- `contacts` (Attributes List) Contact users on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts))
- `country` (String) Two-letter country code.
- `email` (String) Account contact email.
- `email_on_login` (Boolean) True when the account is emailed on each login.
- `id` (String) Customer ID.
- `incident` (Boolean) True when the account receives incident notifications.
- `is_partner` (Boolean) True when the account is a partner account.
- `name` (String) Account holder name.
- `newsletter` (Boolean) True when the account is subscribed to the newsletter.
- `notify_service_renewal` (Boolean) True when the account is notified before a service renews.
- `phone` (String) Contact phone number.
- `province` (String) Province or county.
- `ssh_keys` (Attributes List) SSH keys registered on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_keys))
- `zip` (String) Postal code.

<a id="nestedatt--contacts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts`

Read-Only:

- `access_level` (String) Access level granted to the user.
- `id` (String) Customer ID.
- `name` (String) Account holder name.
- `two_fa` (Boolean) True when two-factor authentication is enabled.
- `username` (String) Login username.


<a id="nestedatt--ssh_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_keys`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (Number) When it was added (Unix seconds).
- `id` (String) Customer ID.
- `name` (String) Account holder name.
